project: Project-Tourist Public Safety & Crime Risk Analysis

license_information.terms_summary: Free access, reuse, and redistribution of Indian Government public datasets with mandatory source attribution and fidelity to published records.

datasets.title: State/UT-wise Incidence & Rate of Total Cognizable IPC Crimes and Major Crime Heads (2014-2016)
datasets.official_source: National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB), Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
datasets.publication: Crime in India (CII) Annual Report, Table 1.1 & Table 1.2
datasets.portal: Open Government Data Platform India (data.gov.in) & ncrb.gov.in
datasets.geographic_level: State and Union Territory Level (36 States & UTs)
datasets.population_source: Mid-Year Projected Population (in Lakhs) computed by the Registrar General of India (RGI) as published in NCRB Crime in India
datasets.rate_calculation: Crime Rate = (Incidence of IPC Crimes / Projected Population in Lakhs) = Crimes per 100,000 population
datasets.preprocessing_notes: Compiled directly from official NCRB tables. State names normalized for UI matching (e.g. 'Jammu & Kashmir' retains historical state status as of 2016 reporting period). Missing historical entries are explicitly preserved as null or 0.

datasets.title: Maharashtra District and Police Commissionerate-wise Incidence of Cognizable IPC Crimes
datasets.official_source: State Crime Records Bureau (SCRB), Maharashtra State CID & NCRB Crime in India
datasets.publication: Crime in Maharashtra / NCRB District-wise Crime in India Table 1.8
datasets.geographic_level: District & Police Commissionerate Level (43 Maharashtra Police Units)
datasets.population_source: Not available for police jurisdiction boundaries (Commissionerates vs Rural District Units)
datasets.rate_calculation: Unavailable. Rate is intentionally NOT calculated because reliable population denominators are not delineated for separate City Commissionerates vs Rural jurisdictions.
datasets.preprocessing_notes: Covers all 43 administrative police units in Maharashtra (10 Commissionerates including Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane City, Pune City, Nagpur City, Nashik City; 31 Rural Districts including Raigad/Panvel, Pune Rural, Satara, Kolhapur; and 2 Railway Police units). Preserves exact reported incidence counts without artificial interpolation or manufactured rates.

datasets.title: Maharashtra State CID Crime Head-wise & District-wise Crime Rates and Incidence (2022 & 2023)
datasets.official_source: State Crime Investigation Department (CID), Maharashtra State
datasets.publication: Crime in Maharashtra (2022 & 2023) Official Annual Reports
datasets.geographic_level: District & Police Commissionerate Level (49 Maharashtra Police Units / 36 Revenue District Groups)
datasets.population_source: Mid-Year Estimated Population in Lakhs computed by Director of Economics and Statistics / Maharashtra CID
datasets.rate_calculation: Crime Rate = (Incidence of Crimes / Mid-Year Population in Lakhs) = Crimes per 100,000 population
datasets.preprocessing_notes: Compiled from official Maharashtra CID Crime Head-Wise and District Rates 2022-2023 reports. Provides comprehensive breakdowns for violent crime, women's safety, and property crimes with verified official rates per 100,000 population.

scientific_disclaimers.weather_correlation: Weather information is supplied solely as contextual environmental awareness for tourist physical safety (e.g. rain, heatwaves, extreme winds). The project makes NO CLAIM that weather predicts or causes crime.
scientific_disclaimers.rate_integrity: Crime rates are presented only where an official population denominator was formally published. No district crime rates are estimated or manufactured from state totals.
